message: Use the latest ARM common-types version 'v6' instead of 'v5'.
The Operation named 'listRecords' should have a documentation or description, use doc comment /** */ to provide it.
Only content-type 'application/json' is supported by ARM
Query parameter 'continuationToken' should be removed. Collection GET/list operations must not have query parameters other than api-version and $filter.
Please provide x-ms-examples describing minimum/maximum property set for response/request payloads for operations.
